_comment: Title pool v4 — max-punch clickbait at the owner's call, still inside YouTube's indexing rules: '{genre} Mix' search phrase early, <=70 chars before the auto [XX Min] tail, ONE emoji, no serial numbering, hooks stay deliverable (a hard-hitting bass mix genuinely backs 'DESTROYS speakers' / 'goes CRAZY'). Placeholders: TRACKNAME, {genre}, {genre_hashtag}.
templates: TRACKNAME 🔥 The {genre} Mix With ZERO Skips | {genre_hashtag}
TRACKNAME 🔥 This {genre} Mix Should Be ILLEGAL | {genre_hashtag}
